items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And his former manager, Rockwell, he and Rockwell had some trouble.

ctx.x: They were in there every night, yeah.

And I'll tell you one thing that really frightened me, and also the band. You see, in 31 we came down here and opened up at the Suburban Gardens. Well, we were broadcast from a place called the Showboat in Chicago, and they heard us, you know. So they engaged Louie to come down here and play. That's the time so many bands met us at the train, you know, at the big parade on Canal Street. Well, we were playing there, and a little bit of my story, Louie, about his time, began his popularity, began to climb, I'd say.…
You know, we're forgetting about where you went to school and all that. Oh, no, I'm not forgetting.
